_comment: Manual player resolution. Consulted BEFORE automatic matching.
Every entry here is a genuine identity, verified against raw.players -
not a fuzzy guess. The automatic resolver reaches 97.8%; the residue is
almost entirely NICKNAME DIVERGENCE between feeds, which no string metric
SGO uses the legal/roster name, nflverse uses the common name.
Cameron -> Cam, Kenneth -> Kenny, Chigoziem -> Chig,
A fuzzy matcher loose enough to join 'Jo'quavious Marks' to 'Woody Marks'
would also join players who are not the same person. Prefer an explicit
NOTE ON TEAM DISAMBIGUATION: raw.players.latest_team is CURRENT, not
historical. Michael Carter (RB) reads TEN today but appears on ARI in
2025 SGO history, so team matching cannot separate him from Michael
Carter II (CB). Ambiguity by name alone must be resolved here.
Keyed by the SGO playerID, which is stable. Add a row whenever

CHIGOZIEM_OKONOKWO_1_NFL.note: nickname; NOTE the SGO playerID misspells the surname as OKONOKWO while their name field spells it correctly - always copy the key from ref.player_xref, never construct it from the name
